requirement: under the 完全权限 preset GPW classifies every path into blacklist (deny), whitelist (allow with budget) or other (GPW pending queue), and the operator can add/remove folders from the panel without editing any profile YAML

assertions.three_classes: deny wins over allow; workspace and whitelist pass; everything else waits
assertions.deny_mechanism: ctx.tools.guard returns a reason (order-independent); pre-execute also denies
assertions.whitelist_budget: auto-allow bounded by rolling window and min gap; exhausted -> pending
assertions.pending_queue: held calls resolve allow/deny from the GPW route; timeout denies
assertions.panel: GpwPanel lists folders, adds via host native picker, shows pending approvals with allow/deny
